offering_description.value: SEI provides fund administration and investment operations services to asset managers and wealth technology and custody to banks and financial advisers. It manages portfolios for institutions and private clients, using its own software and operations teams to deliver these services.

primary_products.value: Wealth management software; investment operations software; mutual funds; exchange-traded funds

primary_services.value: Fund administration; investment operations outsourcing; custody and trust administration; investment management and outsourced chief investment officer services; private wealth advisory

customer_segment.value: B2B: Asset managers, banks, trust companies, financial advisers, corporate pension plans, endowments and foundations; B2C: High-net-worth individuals and families; B2G: Public pension plans

end_markets.value: Asset management; private banking and trust; financial advisory; institutional investing; private wealth management

revenue_model.value: service fees: Fund administration, custody, trust administration and outsourced investment operations; commissions or management fees: Portfolio management, outsourced investment management and private wealth advisory; licensing or royalties: Use of proprietary wealth and investment processing software
revenue_model.category: service fees; commissions or management fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses fund and account records to handle accounting, reporting and back-office operations for investment firms; software / platform: Processes account and transaction data through proprietary platforms for banks, advisers and asset managers; financial intermediary: Manages and safeguards assets for funds, institutions and private clients
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Fund administration, wealth technology, custody, investment management and financial advice

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Dedicated sales and client teams for asset managers, banks, institutions and advisory firms; partners / resellers: Financial advisers and bank wealth teams offering managed portfolios to their clients

regulatory_exposure.value: high: SEC oversight of registered investment advisers and funds, and OCC supervision of the federal trust company

notes: The current scope of smaller ancillary offerings is uncertain.
